data.description: Serve as Senior Software Engineering Manager driving architecture and delivery across Strictly's payment gateway, POS terminal, and Practice Manager Enhancer (PME) healthcare platforms. Led major architecture-hardening initiatives: decomposed an oversized, tightly-coupled payment-processor service into focused, independently testable modules behind a stable facade; removed circular module dependencies in the core terminal service; and introduced distributed locking with automated monitoring to prevent duplicate settlement of transactions. Delivered Elavon/ViaConex payment-processor certification work (CVV handling, address verification, MOTO compliance) ahead of certification cycles, and built FHIR R5-compliant patient-search functionality for the healthcare platform. Coordinates rapid, cross-team security-vulnerability remediation across the company's production services, and led recent development on an internal analytics and operations tool, including its security-hardening pass. Carries ongoing delivery and production-support ownership across the company's two largest engineering workstreams -- payments/gateway and terminal/POS. Also incubating a new fintech payment-recovery initiative through SynerSib Consulting SAS, currently in its early architecture and foundational-security phase.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design innovative software solutions. Streamlined development workflows, increasing team efficiency and reducing time spent on repetitive tasks. Introduced automation tools for efficient deployment processes, minimizing downtime during updates. Developed scalable applications using agile methodologies for timely project delivery. Implemented robust security measures to protect sensitive data and ensure system integrity. Proactively identified areas for process improvement, implementing changes that led to significant time savings for the team. Mentored junior developers, fostering professional growth and enhancing team productivity. Enhanced software functionality by identifying and resolving complex technical issues. Optimized code performance for improved user experience and system efficiency.

Contributed to a positive team environment through effective communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills. Optimized application performance by conducting regular code reviews and refactoring when necessary. Developed customized software solutions for diverse clients, resulting in increased satisfaction and repeat business.

Contributed to open-source projects, sharing knowledge with the broader community while gaining valuable insights from other experienced professionals. Optimized algorithms for faster processing, reducing overall computation time. Integrated new technologies into existing systems, increasing capabilities and improving overall performance. Consistently met project deadlines by effectively managing time and prioritizing tasks according to importance.

Founded and lead SynerSib Consulting SAS, the consulting practice through which senior software engineering and technical-leadership services are delivered to Strictly's payment-technology platform. Also incubating a new fintech product aimed at helping merchant networks recover failed and overdue customer payments, currently in its early architecture and foundational-security phase.
